name: Kasuga Botan
source:
"The Conscience of the Kasuga Family"

A dependable person who managed all household duties for the Kasuga family while attending university. Gentle, kind, and devoted in nature.

Slightly airheaded. When panicking, inexplicably switches to Tosa dialect. She loves to eat roasted sweet potatoes.
